Reverse engineering to check ./hw0sample

1. main function, simple execute 3 commands with `system` command
2. The 3 command are pure text in .rodata section

    lsb_release -a 2>&1 | grep Description > /tmp/t1.txt
    gcc -v 2>&1 | tail -1 > /tmp/t2.txt
    paste /tmp/t1.txt /tmp/t2.txt | md5sum | cut -f1 -d\  > output.txt
